profile.headline: Senior Developer
profile.summary:
Experienced and ambitious full-stack software engineer looking to bring a little creativity to the dev scene!

FRONT END & GRAPHICS – Javascript, React, Redux, Angular, Vue, jQuery, HTML, CSS, Less, Sass, Webflow, GSAP, ScrollMagic, Ionic, Bootstrap, Foundation, Flexbox, CSS Grid, Backbone, D3, Web Accessibility WCAG 2.2, Lottie, Photoshop, Illustrator, XD, Figma, InDesign, Sketch, Invision, MarvelApp, Principle, Design Thinking

BACK END & MARCOM – Wordpress, Adobe Experience Manager, Hubspot CMS, Marketo, Drupal, Shopify, Booqable, Craft CMS, ExpressionEngine, PHP, GraphQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Mongoose, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, Express, Android SDK, Cordova, Node, AWS, Digital Ocean, GIT, Sourcetree, Travis CI, Knex, REST, Mocha, Karma, Chai, Webpack, Postman, Agile, MariaDB, Apache, Nginx, Google Cloud Platform, Vercel, MAMP, Local, Google Web Designer, Adobe Animate

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.locationName: New Orleans, Louisiana, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Providing front-end responsive web design and development support for full sites and features, using html/css/php/js

Managing website installs, integrations, upgrades, updates, SEO and troubleshooting support

Facilitating internal/client domain hosting and server maintenance processes for new and inherited websites

Expanding website development offerings by strategically applying new approaches and tools to maximize client objectives and advance/grow tech capabilities

Supporting business development and account management in developing estimates with recommended technologies and solutions
positions.insights: Skills: Search Engine Marketing (SEM) · GreenSock Animation Platform (GSAP) · Front-End Development · HTML5 · Web Development · Webpack

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Participation in all aspects of web build life cycle including design, UX, architecture, implementation, and deployment.

Planning and development of all CMS themes (Wordpress, Craft and Expression Engine) in communion with any relevant web technologies, frameworks and third-party integrations

Managing team of freelance developers, helping to best match skill-set with website functional specifications 

Research, establish, implement and streamline company-wide hand-off process of mockups from designer to developer

Help to create current company technical standards for all web builds

Create and implement current company SEO standards in accordance with industry best practices

Construction and management of LAMP stack environment across multiple platforms, including cloud computing integration

Plan and build email templates to spec for multiple email platforms and CRMs
positions.insights: Skills: Search Engine Marketing (SEM) · GreenSock Animation Platform (GSAP) · Front-End Development · HTML5 · Vue.js · Web Development · Webpack

positions.title: Digital Coordinator
positions.description:
Implement and oversee development and maintenance of client websites, blogs, newsletters, social media and search marketing campaigns.

Initiate and maintain contact with external site owners to support SEO and PR campaigns.

Successfully build A/B tests on client websites with the purpose of increasing form and telephone conversion rates using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and PHP.

Aggregation and compilation of data for monthly reports to clients. 

Utilize Google Webmaster Tools and Analytics to measure keyword strength against site traffic and rankings

Setup and optimize Pay-Per-Click Campaigns (PPC) using Google Adwords and Bing Ads
positions.insights: Skills: Search Engine Marketing (SEM) · HTML5 · Web Development

positions.title: SEO Analyst
positions.description:
Analysis of metadata and SEO techniques of competitor online toy stores

Examine Google Analytics to fine-tune the parameters of company SEM campaign

Prepared Monthly SEO Audits with tiered, actionable suggestions to guide client ranking goals

Analyzing and processing vendor invoices

Assisting customers with purchases, product and delivery issues
positions.insights: Skills: Search Engine Marketing (SEM) · HTML5 · Web Development

projects.title: Birdwatch
projects.description:
*Tracks recent bird watchers and sightings from all over the world*

Utilized React Dropzone to generate clean image-uploads to Cloudinary while adjusting
component architecture to protect against memory leaks

Extended usability by implementation of React’s Material UI components within user
generated content

projects.title: Pet Detective
projects.description:
*Social crowdsourcing app to connect individuals with their lost and found pets*

Created application in AngularJS specifically for ready access to directives for better
modularizing code

Implemented precise locational usability by integrating Google Maps and Places APIs
within search

Crafted responsive structure for mobile devices utilizing Bootstrap CSS
